Scale each existing input item embedding by 1 + 0.25*min(log1p(c),2), where c counts earlier occurrences of that item in the supplied sequence prefix; keep padding zero and reproduce this feature in prediction. Weight the original per-position prediction loss by 0.5 + 0.5*exp(-d/10), normalized over valid positions, where d is distance from the latest training target. Repeat salience exposes persistent interests while recent-target weighting focuses learning on their current relevance.
